title: heracleum sphondylium subsp. cyclocarpum
intro: Heracleum sphondylium subsp. cyclocarpum, commonly known as wild angelica, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of wild angelica include its ability to soothe digestive issues, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
